name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center Amdjarass
developer: ADETIC (Agence de developpement des technologies de l'information et de la communication, state agency); ENST (Ecole Nationale Superieure de Technologies) for training/maintenance
notes: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center (telecentre) inaugurated 31 March 2019 in Amdjarass, Ennedi Est, built at 386,396,956 FCFA. Includes a computer room for public training, cybercafe, 120-seat multimedia conference room, a room equipped with servers, and technician office. Alwihda also confirms six ADETIC multimedia telecentres were built/equipped nationwide (Mongo, Abeche, Bongor, Doba, Biltine, Amdjarass). Classified institutional ICT/telecentre facility with a server room, NOT a commercial data center or colocation.

name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center Mongo
notes: ADETIC multimedia telecentre at Mongo (Guera) is one of six ADETIC community multimedia centers built and equipped nationwide (Mongo, Abeche, Bongor, Biltine, Amdjarass, Doba) per Alwihda (2019) and Tchadinfos reporting on the ADETIC telecentre program. Institutional ICT/telecentre facility; no public data on server capacity or commercial colocation. A local radio (Sot-Al-Nadja) also operates from Mongo per N'Djamena Actu, unrelated to DC activity.

name: DTS trans-Saharan fiber project - Massaguet technical site / network operations center
developer: DTS (Dorsale Transsaharienne a fibre optique) project - Ministry of Telecommunications; EU-funded (EUR 29m); works consortium CGPS/LORYNE
notes: Minister Boukar Michel inspected the DTS technical site under construction at Massaguet (Hadjer-Lamis) on 9 Jan 2026; the site is described as the fiber-optic network operations center (NOC) of the DTS project, visited earlier by University of N'Djamena delegation with the AfDB project lead (Oct 2024). DTS links Chad to the Mediterranean network via Niger (503 km Chad section from Massaguet to the Niger border, launched May 2023; works delayed). Fiber installations near Massakory (511 km route for Hadjer-Lamis toward Bol) were vandalized twice. Classified telecom transmission/NOC infrastructure, NOT a commercial data center.

name: DTS trans-Saharan fiber route - Kanem zone
developer: DTS (Dorsale Transsaharienne a fibre optique) project - Ministry of Telecommunications; EU-funded (EUR 29m)
notes: The DTS project coordinator (Ahmat Badawi Hamit) states the project covers the Kanem, Lac and Hadjer-Lamis provinces (technical sites and fiber installation zones, works ongoing since 2023). No named technical site or server facility in Mao/Kanem found in this sweep; record is a transmission/fiber-route lead only (C grade), NOT a data center.

name: DTS trans-Saharan fiber project - Bol technical site
developer: DTS (Dorsale Transsaharienne a fibre optique) project - Ministry of Telecommunications; EU-funded (EUR 29m); contractor for technical-site construction
notes: Inspection mission (11 Jan 2026) found significant degradations at the DTS technical site of Bol (Lac province): windows of the building meant to host technical equipment/materials broken, compromising installation security; contractor ordered to reinforce security. DTS works (launched 2023) delayed due to control-mission mobilization issues. Classified telecom transmission/technical site infrastructure, NOT a commercial data center.

name: PMICE Doba digital-infrastructure sites (fiber, transmission pylons, multimedia center, SOTEL installations)
developer: PMICE (Projet de Modernisation des Infrastructures de Communications Electroniques) - Ministry of Telecommunications; Huawei delivery partner
notes: Minister Boukar Michel inspected PMICE digital infrastructure in Logone Oriental (Doba) in early May 2025: fiber-optic sites, transmission pylons, a multimedia center and SOTEL installations (WeAreTech, 6 May 2025). Doba is the western endpoint of the PMICE Phase I fiber line (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba) provisionally inaugurated at Sarh on 20 Dec 2025 (reception provisoire; Huawei representative present). Phase I provisional reception acted; final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites still pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/technical sites, NOT commercial DC.

name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center Doba
notes: ADETIC community multimedia center in Doba was the 5th of six ADETIC telecentres inaugurated (with a computer room, equipped cybercafe and a 120-person meeting room). N'Djamena Actu (19 Jan 2025) reports the center has been out of service more than four years after inauguration ('a l'abandon'). Current operational status unknown/abandoned; institutional ICT/telecentre facility, NOT a commercial data center.
